# Smart Study Center (SSC) - Online Education Platform
> Love to Know. Quality online education, personalized mentorship, and academic excellence for students from Class 6th through A-Levels and University Entry Tests.

Smart Study Center (originally established in 2008 as Pakistan Science and Commerce Academy) is a premier online educational institution providing structured live classes, one-on-one mentorship, and comprehensive test preparation. We specialize in catering to students in Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, UAE, and the global diaspora who require high-standard education aligned with FBISE, Cambridge (CAIE/Edexcel), and university entrance exams.

## Quick Facts
- **Website**: https://www.smartstudycenter.com
- **WhatsApp**: +92 300 0412637 (https://wa.me/923000412637)
- **Email**: support.smartstudycenter@gmail.com / info@smartstudycenter.com
- **Headquarters**: Lahore, Pakistan (Serving students worldwide)
- **Target Levels**: Class 6th–8th (Juniors), Matric (9th–10th), Intermediate (F.Sc / ICS / I.Com), O-Levels (CAIE/IGCSE), A-Levels, and Entry Tests (MDCAT, ECAT, NET, FAST, GIKI).

---

## Core Academic Programs

### 1. Intermediate Programs (HSSC / 11th & 12th)
- **URL**: https://www.smartstudycenter.com/courses/intermediate
- **Streams**: Pre-1st Year, F.Sc Pre-Medical, F.Sc Pre-Engineering, I.C.S (Computer Science), I.COM (Commerce), FA (IT & General).
- **Features**: Complete board syllabus coverage (FBISE & Provincial), chapter-wise test series, formula booklets, entry test integrated questions.

### 2. A-Level Programs (Cambridge & Edexcel)
- **URL**: https://www.smartstudycenter.com/courses/a-level
- **Streams**: AS-Level (Year 1), A2-Level (Year 2), Medical Sciences Track, Engineering & Tech Track.
- **Features**: Past paper marathons (2015–2024), marking scheme rubrics, examiner report breakdowns, university application counseling.

### 3. O-Level / IGCSE Programs (Cambridge Assessment)
- **URL**: https://www.smartstudycenter.com/courses/o-level
- **Streams**: O-1 (Foundations), O-2 (Core Exam Focus), O-3 (Exam Preparation & Mocks), Science Group, Commerce Group.
- **Features**: Early completion of compulsory subjects (Islamiyat 2058, Pakistan Studies 2059), ATP (Alternative to Practical) labs, topical question drills.

### 4. Matriculation Programs (9th & 10th Class)
- **URL**: https://www.smartstudycenter.com/courses/matric
- **Streams**: 9th Class Science, 10th Class Science, Pre-9th Foundation, General/Arts Group.
- **Features**: SLO (Student Learning Outcomes) based teaching for FBISE & Punjab Boards, board paper presentation techniques, full-book grand test series.

### 5. Junior Section (Classes 6th to 8th)
- **URL**: https://www.smartstudycenter.com/courses/juniors
- **Streams**: Class 6th, Class 7th, Class 8th, Foundation English & Math Booster.
- **Features**: Interactive live classes, arithmetic and conceptual science foundations, homework assistance.

### 6. University Entry Test Master Prep
- **URL**: https://www.smartstudycenter.com/courses/entry-test
- **Streams**: MDCAT (Medical Colleges), ECAT (UET & Engineering), NET (NUST), FAST & GIKI Prep.
- **Features**: 10,000+ high-yield MCQs, shortcut mental math techniques, full-length simulation papers (FLPs), rank analytics.

## Our Core Values
- **URL**: https://www.smartstudycenter.com/values
- **Affordable Quality Education**: Ensuring excellent education is financially accessible for every family regardless of geographic location.
- **Student-Centred Learning**: Tailored individual attention addressing unique learning paces and goals.
- **Career Guidance and Counselling**: Proactive subject selection and academic pathway advising.
- **Integrity and Respect**: Fostering discipline, honesty, and responsible mentorship.
- **Continuous Improvement**: Updating online learning methodologies and digital tools.
- **Confidence and Growth**: Encouraging critical inquiry and overcoming academic obstacles.
